notes:
Inbound SMB lead from support automation market. Self-serve signup, has been testing hosted API with trial key. Primary product interest: hosted_api (want simple fast onboarding). Use cases: automated ticket summarization (summarize incoming tickets into concise TL;DR + tags), structured outputs for downstream ticketing system (strict JSON schema), and tool-calling to perform ticket actions (close, escalate, add internal note).

Key requirements / quotes: 
- "Need reliable JSON output to push into our ticket pipeline, can't have free-form text breaking parsers."
- "Latency target: p95 <= 350ms for 1-2k monthly active agents; throughput currently low (10-20 rps) but we want headroom to 50 rps."
- Cost sensitivity: high, SMB budget; prefers pay-as-you-go hosted pricing.
- Model preferences: lean on open models or mid-size options, but flexible if Redwood offers cost/latency tradeoffs. Wants guidance on batching vs streaming for short summaries.

Security/Compliance: SOC2 mandatory for procurement sign-off, SSO/SAML required (already use Okta), audit logs for agent edits requested. Data residency: US is fine. No on-prem or VPC needed at this stage.

POC criteria (from call):
- 3 example workflows validated end-to-end (incoming ticket -> structured JSON -> tool call to update ticket)
- JSON schema compliance >= 98% on 200 sample tickets
- Latency p95 <= 350ms on 50 rps simulated load
- Est. cost per summarized ticket <= $0.02 (target)
